proposal:
SCOPE. Hand-derived, nothing executed. One unimplemented mechanism (PCE, padding-closed elimination), one diagnosis of the measured 16, one fixture for the deployed solver. No completeness or polynomial-SAT claim.

DIAGNOSIS. Let F = G∘π with disjoint XOR forms of weight w. Resolving F on x in supp(ℓ) produces every G-resolvent once per sign pattern of the other variables of ℓ: 2^(w-1) copies. Canon subsumes but never merges siblings C∨z, C∨¬z, so the copies survive and the count test rejects steps that G accepts. On the 96-clause core (G = 6 binary clauses on 4 parities) every root candidate fails: x1 gives 128 resolvents against 48 removed. Once two variables of one triple are assigned, that form has residual weight 1; then x10 passes (32 new, 36 removed) and elimination runs to refutation. This matches receipt 00029: 2,4,8,16 while no triple has two assigned variables, then 0 at variable 2, with 192 = 32 nodes × 6 accepted steps. Conjectured reading: the 16 is 2^(prefix rank of forms before any form reaches residual weight 1), an artifact of padding and order, not hardness of G.

MECHANISM. Add to Canon the equivalence-preserving rule: replace C∨z and C∨¬z by C, to fixpoint, then subsume; ELIM accepts on the merged count. Soundness is one resolution plus one subsumption per merge: a local lemma, with no stabilizers, basis, certificate, 2^n enumeration or caps. Extra clauses cannot switch it off; unpadded clauses simply do not merge. Per node: at most n accepted steps, n candidates each, m^2/4 resolvents of width at most n, so O(n^3 m^2) literal operations plus merge passes, with clause count never above m. That bounds node work, not the number of nodes.

INDEPENDENT-TEST PREDICTION (compression disabled, PCE on). The 00029 fixture is refuted at root, peak 0, in any order. Hand-traced accepting path: x1 (at most 85 clauses after merges, including four resolvents of the first wide clause), x2 pure, then the remaining parities; merges also collapse (p2∨p4),(p2∨¬p4) to p2. For auto00008 I predict nothing. Run it: either a root solve, meaning the greedy skip was an encoding artifact, or a recorded state where every candidate's merged count exceeds the pre-step count. That state, not the skip, is the harder-trace evidence.

FIXTURE (deployed v2). Core 96 clauses plus two strict supersets of core clauses, [1..8] and [1,2,7,8,-9,10,11,-12], as singleton blocks covering all 12 variables. Predicted: BLQ skips (all_variables_in_odd_blocks), because the brief says it runs before Canon and normalizes only duplicates and tautologies; Canon then subsumes both extras. Order 1..12: layer x1 retains 2 (all eleven candidates fail; x10 gives 64 new against 40 removed). At layer x2 both parity classes are refuted by ELIM (x10, then x3 and x11, which pass only through final-Canon subsumption). If counts were taken before subsumption the layers would be 2,2,1,2,0. Peak 2 under both readings, against 16 for the same core in interleaved order.
Reading the outcome: skip with peak 2 means logically redundant clauses defeat compression while the trace is easy. Compression with peak 0 means BLQ already subsumes and my reading of the brief is wrong. Peak above 2 falsifies my ELIM model.
missing_theorem: T9. (a) Lift commutation, routine but unchecked. Let F = lift_π(G), π disjoint XOR forms with weights w_ℓ, x in supp(ℓ), and E_v = DP elimination of v followed by merge fixpoint and subsumption. Claim: E_x(F) = lift_π'(E_yℓ(G)), π' = π without ℓ, and |lift(D)| = ∏_{ℓ in D} 2^(w_ℓ−1). So acceptance on F is a weighted acceptance test on G. To prove: tautology correspondence when two G-clauses share forms; confluence of merge on full padding cubes; commutation with subsumption. (b) The first real gap. The weighted test is not width-invariant: replacing two k-clauses by one (2k−2)-clause changes weight from 2·2^((w−1)k) to 2^((w−1)(2k−2)), rejected for k ≥ 3, w ≥ 2. Needed: a discovery-free, polynomially computable acceptance measure invariant under disjoint XOR lifting, or a proof that none exists while keeping formula size polynomial. Candidate, unproved: count exact-support blocks under a support-size cap. (c) The only growth bound I can currently prove: with literal residual dedup and deterministic node processing, retained states after prefix U ≤ 2^c(U) · 2^e(U), where c(U) is the rank of the restrictions to U of annihilator forms of blocks meeting both U and its complement, and e(U) counts live unstable clauses. No bound independent of order or of G is claimed.
self_attack:
1. Not new mathematics. Sibling merge is a special case of subsumption resolution; DP elimination with subsumption and strengthening is standard preprocessing. The contribution is the lift-commutation statement and its use to explain a measured trace.
2. Overlapping forms break T9a. A variable in two forms makes elimination a Tseitin-type step; resolution on Tseitin formulas over expanders is exponential (Urquhart), and merging does not help. HNF handles pure parity; nonlinear G over overlapping forms is untouched. auto00008 probably lives here.
3. Nonlinear gadgets (auto00009 style) produce no full padding cubes; merge fires partially or not at all.
4. Gap (b) means lifts of 3-CNF are not covered, and lifts of resolution-hard G stay hard for any elimination. This extends a tractable family; it is not completeness.
5. Greedy acceptance is path dependent. T9a is one step; occurrence products scale with weights, so the F path may not mirror a successful G path.
6. Fixture risks. The skip rests on the brief's wording and on one receipt for the odd-block rule. My ELIM model (try every candidate in product/ID order, accept the first whose final count is not larger) is inferred from one receipt. IALH refuting earlier would lower the peak, not raise it. The fixture tests the diagnosis and the deployed solver, not PCE.
7. The fixture's adversary is shallow: subsuming before block grouping removes it. The 00029 extras were not subsumed and caused the same skip, so that patch is not the repair.
8. Merge changes syntactic residuals, so dedup and stronger-disjunct pruning may behave differently on existing controls. Soundness is unaffected; effectiveness needs regression.
9. All counts are hand arithmetic over 16-clause blocks; one wrong sign pattern changes which candidate passes.
mechanism_signature: PCE | unimplemented | Canon += sibling merge (C∨z, C∨¬z → C) to fixpoint, then subsume; ELIM accepts on merged count | no discovery, certificate, enumeration or caps | disjoint XOR lifts: F-step = lift(G-step), clause weight ∏2^(w−1) | fails on overlapping forms (Tseitin), nonlinear gadgets, widening resolvents | node cost O(n^3 m^2), node count unbounded | fixture targets deployed v2: subsumed extras ⇒ skip; order 1..12 ⇒ peak 2
delta_from_prior: RWQ (00028) and RAQ (00029) repaired the quotient itself: relaxations, better bases, transversals for extra clauses. Both stayed root-only and kept discovery plus a 2^n certificate. This proposal stops repairing the quotient and attacks why it was needed. It explains the measured 16 as a padding artifact of the clause-count test, replaces global form discovery with a local equivalence-preserving rule, and gives a polynomial per-node cost without caps. New hand-derived diagnostics: ELIM unlocks exactly when some form's residual weight reaches 1, and logically redundant superset clauses are enough to defeat BLQ. The Rado/deficiency machinery is not used here.
